## Actions

- First mutation run (mutmut 3.8.0 on backend/app): 27 mutants, 24 killed, 3 survived. All three
  removed the documented sort order of `unclassified()`. Action taken the same day:
  `test_unclassified_routes_are_sorted_by_path_then_method`; rerun killed 27 of 27.
- Defect #1 (S2, P1): fixed the day it was found; verification by Matthew Wilson by October 27, 2026.
- Defect #2 (S3, P3, deferred): revisit when ADR 0001 is accepted (owner Dane Niblett).

Escaped defects this month: none (nothing is released).
